svg.title: Phase 5 iteration 1 training interface states
svg.desc: Training interaction states cover week navigation, workout logging, stable set repair, completed history, lifecycle controls, a concise no-program entry through the navigation action, program-only manual creation, and a separate add-week authoring page.

g.text: Gym logging stays sparse and immediate. Prescription is reference; execution begins empty. Stable set slots, explicit lifecycle actions, and open-ended authoring preserve real-world corrections.
One blank editor only. No target prefill, set compaction, completeness gate, expected week count, or separate substitution workflow.
Returns to the same stable set slots.
